hypotheses.reasoning: order-consumer crashes on the same message every time: msg-147644 at offset 885603, with a RangeError (maximum call stack size exceeded) in expandReferences. That looks like a self-referencing or very deeply nested payload. The consumer restarts from the same committed offset and crashes again, so it is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff and lag keeps growing. The other services stay healthy throughout and the consumer runs the same version on every restart (v1.3.0), so this is not a dependency problem or a deploy.
Possible but unlikely. The consumer processed batches normally on v1.3.0 before this one message. No deploy event appears in the window.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-147644 (offset 885603) on orders.events to a DLQ, or skip it by committing offset 885604, so the consumer can catch up. Then fix expandReferences: add cycle detection and a depth limit, and catch errors for each message so bad messages go to the DLQ instead of crashing the process. Inspect the bad payload to find which producer sent it.
